text:
alex: Heads-up — canary in eu-west failed during the postdeploy smoke. 502 spikes, looks config-related (values overlay)
maria: Saw it. Deploy-bot flagged health checks. Can you paste the diff you used for the overlay?

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary health check failed for myservice:release 3.2.1-canary (eu-west). Failed pods: myservice-5f8d6b7c. Healthcheck: 3/10 failures in last minute.

jordan: quick triage — rolling back the canary or pin the chart? Change window is still open for 20m.

alex: Overlay diff (generated by values-merge):
```
--- base.values.yaml
+++ overlay.values.yaml
@@ -12,6 +12,8 @@
  ingress:
    enabled: true
+    path: /api/v2
+    rewrite: true
  service:
    port: 8080
    annotations: {}
```

maria: hmm path/rewrite were meant only for the internal staging overlay, not prod. That would route upstream differently -> 502.

sam: Is the chart version bumped? We deployed 3.2.1-canary with the same image tag as stable. Chart changes should've been gated.

alex: Chart is 3.2.1-canary (helm release annotated by deploy-bot). Values overlay accidentally included staging overlay in the merged set.

prod-oncall: If we revert the values overlay immediately we should restore traffic in ~30s after pods restart. Risk: may reintroduce an old path change for other regions?

jordan: Options: 1) rollback to last stable release (3.2.0) — quick, but reverts other unrelated chart fixes. 2) patch values (remove ingress.path and rewrite) and hotpatch release (3.2.1-hotfix) — minimal change, keeps chart fixes.

maria: I can push a values-only hotfix now. Suggest patch + pin canary until we validate. We'll create release notes that this was a values overlay mistake.

alex: Runbook commands:
```bash
# patch values and promote as hotfix
helm upgrade --install myservice ./charts/myservice -f values.yaml -f hotfix.values.yaml --set image.tag=sha-abc123 --namespace prod
# wait for rollout
kubectl rollout status deploy/myservice -n prod --timeout=90s
```

sam: Also add an admission check to deploy-bot to disallow overlays named "staging" from merging into prod overlays. I'll open a tiny PR.

deploy-bot: Manual pin requested by @maria: pin myservice chart to 3.2.0 for eu-west until hotfix validated. Automated rollback NOT performed.

jordan: Good. Maria, do the patch and ping when ready. Sam, can you gate the merge rule? If not immediate, we should add a preflight to block overlays with path/rewrite keys in prod.

maria: Pushing hotfix now. Will annotate release notes: "hotfix(values): remove staging-ingress overlay accidentally merged; fixes 502s in eu-west canary". ETA 8m.

alex: After hotfix, let's keep the canary pinned (deploy-bot pin) and run full e2e for eu-west for 30m. If green, unpin and promote.

prod-oncall: Keep page awake. I'll watch for any cross-region side-effects.

maria: Done — hotfix released as 3.2.1-hotfix (values-only). Logs look clean, 200s stable. Rolling e2e now.

alex: Thanks. Once e2e passes, we should update release notes and add a short postmortem blurb: cause=overlay-merge-mistag, action=preflight-overlay-name-check + deploy-bot rule.

sam: Opened PR #4224 to add overlay-name block and a schema check for ingress.rewrite in prod overlays.

jordan: Agree. Also add a line to release-notes: "Do not include staging overlays in prod merges" and link PR.

maria: TL;DR: hotfix applied, canary pinned, e2e running, follow-ups: deploy-bot preflight + release-note blurb. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Pin cleared on request after validation window. (automated)
